title: 第21章 斩杀先天境三重第22章 以后你就是我大哥了
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: “林刀，他终于要出手了吗？”
“传闻这家伙乃是刀痴，天赋更是不在那林剑之下，这一战，有的看了。”
“若那李轩能够击败林刀，那就真的太逆天了，应该不大可能吗？”
伴随着林刀的走出，所有人的目光顷刻间便是汇聚到了他的身上。
林家林刀，这位可是苍阳城极负盛名的人物，实力无比的恐怖。
他的刀，更是以霸道刚猛着称，曾经更是斩杀过先天境四重强者。
林刀一步步走出，向着擂台而去。
他每前进一步，气势便是会更强三分。
当他登上擂台之后，身上的气势更是彻底攀升到了极点。
给人的感觉，他整个人都好像变成了刀，霸道刚猛，强势绝伦。
这一刻，莫说台下那些人，哪怕是杨家三爷等强者，脸色都是不由变得凝重了起来。
“三叔，李轩会是林刀的对手吗？”
感受着林刀身上那股强悍无匹的气息，杨芊芊的俏脸上都是不由浮现出了凝重，冲着身旁的杨无极问道。
杨无极摇头，“难，这个林刀很强，不太容易对付。”
杨芊芊闻言，内心瞬间一凛，“那怎么办，万一李轩不敌，您——”
李轩这样的妖孽，若是死了，那就太可惜了。
撇开李轩必定能够加入神炎宗，能够给他杨家带来利益不谈，单只是李轩这天赋，这实力，也不能死在这里啊。
另外一边。
林家人看到林刀上台，则是忍不住狞笑了起来。
“李轩，你的好运到头了，准备受死吧。”
“区区一个垃圾，竟然也敢挑衅我林家，你马上就会付出代价。”
“刀哥，杀了他，杀了他！”
这些林家子弟，一个个心里都是憋足了气，憋的几欲吐血。
现在看到林刀出场，终于是忍不住宣泄了出来。
李轩废了他林家那么多人，甚至还杀了林剑，这个场子要是不找回来，他们以后在苍阳城就没办法抬头了。
林刀没有理会那些林家人的叫喊，而是抬头看向了李轩。
轰！
当他眼神落在李轩身上的时候，一股霸道无匹的气势就宛若泰山压顶般狠狠砸在李轩身上，直击灵魂深处。
若是一般人，单只这一个对视，怕是就会受到影响，心生恐惧。
只不过，李轩却并非一般人。
他手持凡剑，同样盯着林刀，面色一如既往般平静。
只不过，他的内心却是极其凝重，不敢有丝毫大意。
炼气境九重，先天境三重，足足差了一个大境界和三个小境界。
再加上这林刀在先天境三重中也不算是那种菜鸡弱者，所以，这样的差距，可不是那么好弥补的。
content_en:
"Lin Dao, is he finally going to take action?"
"It is rumored that this guy is a swordsman, and his talent is not as good as that of Na Linjian. Some people watched this battle."
"If Li Xuan can defeat Lin Dao, it would be really unbelievable. Isn't it impossible?"
As Lin Dao walked out, everyone's eyes immediately focused on him.
Lin Dao of the Lin family is a very famous figure in Cangyang City, and his strength is extremely terrifying.
His sword is even more famous for its dominance and fierceness, and he has even killed a fourth-level Xiantian realm expert.
Lin Dao walked out step by step and headed towards the ring.
Every time he takes a step forward, his momentum will become three points stronger.
When he stepped onto the ring, his momentum reached an all-time high.
It gives the impression that his whole body has turned into a sword, he is domineering, fierce and extremely powerful.
At this moment, not to mention those people in the audience, even the strong men such as the third master of the Yang family, their faces could not help but become solemn.
"Third uncle, will Li Xuan be Lin Dao's opponent?"
Feeling the powerful aura on Lin Dao's body, Yang Qianqian couldn't help but look serious on her pretty face, and asked Yang Wuji beside her.
Yang Wuji shook his head, "It's difficult. This Lin Dao is very strong and not easy to deal with."
When Yang Qianqian heard this, her heart suddenly trembled, "What should I do? If Li Xuan loses, you-"
It would be a pity if a monster like Li Xuan died.
Leaving aside the fact that Li Xuan will definitely be able to join the Shenyan Sect and bring benefits to the Yang family, Li Xuan's talent and strength alone cannot die here.
The other side.
When the Lin family saw Lin Dao coming on stage, they couldn't help laughing.
"Li Xuan, your luck is over, prepare to die."
"A mere piece of trash actually dares to provoke our Lin family. You will pay the price immediately."
"Brother Dao, kill him, kill him!"
Each and every one of these Lin family disciples was so full of breath that they almost wanted to vomit blood.
Now that I saw Lin Dao appear, I finally couldn't help but let it out.
Li Xuan crippled so many members of his Lin family and even killed Lin Jian. If this place is not recovered, they will not be able to raise their heads in Cangyang City in the future.
Lin Dao ignored the shouts of the Lin family members and looked up at Li Xuan.
boom!
When his eyes fell on Li Xuan, an unparalleled aura hit Li Xuan like a mighty mountain, hitting the depths of his soul.
If an ordinary person looked at each other just like this, they would be affected and fearful.
However, Li Xuan is not an ordinary person.
He held the mortal sword and stared at Lin Dao, his expression as calm as ever.
However, his heart was extremely solemn and he did not dare to be careless in the slightest.
The ninth level of the Qi Refining Realm and the third level of the Innate Realm are one big and three small realms away.
In addition, Lin Dao is not a weakling in the third level of Xiantian Realm, so this gap is not easy to make up for.
title_en: Chapter 21: Killing the Third Level of the Innate Realm Chapter 22: You will be my big brother from now on
